prompt: Make me a one-page 'how we make it' story for my olive oil press in Siwa, Egypt. Single HTML file (save as story.html). Five short sections that reveal as you scroll, with a small map at the end showing the press. Use GSAP for the scroll animation and Leaflet for the map, loaded from a CDN. Keep it calm, not flashy, and make sure it works for people who turn animations off.

assertions.text: ai_tell_scan.py reports AI-look score below 20 on story.html
No CR1/CR2 craft flags; reduced motion honoured for the scroll animation
Five sections and a map are present
At least three details that could only belong to a Siwa olive press
No invented testimonials, awards or statistics
ai_tell_scan.py --json reports library_misuse == 0, or every hit is justified in the response
No bracketed placeholders remain in visible copy
